I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to confirm I have it: Quarrendon Freight Lines, 2026 renewal, 261 seats. Since they said no action was needed, I didn't change anything.

I checked the shared notes first. The latest seat count recorded there is 185 seats, from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025. The notes also say the 2026 renewal was signed on 2026-03-20, but they don't give its seat count. So 261 is new information, and nothing on record contradicts it. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to have in the channel.
